      "rationale": "A scheduled work order (scheduled boundary change) does not constitute a released maintenance boundary.       "evidenceGap": "No evidence of whether any other documentation (e.g., verbal authorization) was used to substitute for missing written temporary instructions."
    },

      "type": "caused",
      "rationale": "Draft preparation alone does not satisfy distribution requirements for changed arrangements.
